description: This file defines a strategy function for streaming responses or falling back to concatenated responses in environments lacking support for modern streaming APIs. It is part of the Workbox library, specifically in the 'streams' module, and facilitates creating middleware-like routing strategies for response handling.

methods.name: strategy(sourceFunctions, headersInit)
methods.description: Creates a response strategy function that handles streaming responses if supported, or fallback concatenated responses if not. It processes an array of source functions that generate response parts and manages the response creation accordingly.
